title: libre-ai.produit.v1 — one product of the catalogue
description: One file per product under ecosystem/produits/ (catalogue of ADR-0042 §1): what the product does, for whom, what it does not do and which other products it relies on. No field states an advancement: the state of a product is read in the project.v1.yaml card of its carrier repository. Rules that need another source are enforced by ecosystem/check-produits.ts, each under its own name, not by this schema: the identifier is the file name and is in the catalogue; the category is the domain the ADR gives the product; exactly one of nom_public and nom_provisoire is set; a dependency names another fiche; the carrier is in the repository inventory; a fiche carries exactly three etiquettes; a_relire names fields of this schema.

nom_public.description: The name decided for the public, or null while none is decided.

nom_provisoire.description: A working name, or null once a public name is decided.

intitule.description: The product as the catalogue of ADR-0042 §1 words it.

fonction.description: What kind of tool it is, in a few words.

categorie.description: The domain of the catalogue, as an identifier. The checker holds it to the domain ADR-0042 §1 gives the product.

promesse.description: What the product is meant to bring, in one sentence. An intention, not a statement that it exists.

a_la_place_de.description: The kind of tool the product is meant to replace, described without naming a brand or a service.

depend_de.description: Other products this one relies on. Links between products: a cycle is admitted.

depot.description: The carrier repository, or null when the inventory holds none for this product.

etiquettes.description: Short labels. The checker counts them: exactly three.

a_relire.description: Names of the fields of this fiche that are proposals of an agent, not yet reread by the owner. The checker holds each name to the properties of this schema.

ligne.description: A short line: no control character, so that a value printed by the gate cannot forge a line of its output.

phrase.description: One line of prose, without a control character.
